entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Planeswalker who is named Commander-General by the dying Vorik and rallies the Zendikari to retake Sea Gate.

entities.name: Commander Vorik
entities.description: The Zendikari commander who dies of Eldrazi corruption after naming Gideon his successor.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: Vorik's most trusted advisor, wearing a glowing halo, who opposes Gideon's plan but ultimately pledges to fight with him.

entities.name: Abeena
entities.description: A kor rope-handler who helps Gideon move the waterfall.

entities.name: Seble
entities.description: An elf skyrider on a manta who patrols the camp's skies.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who left for the Eye of Ugin with Jori En.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A merfolk who left with Jace for the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Sky Rock
entities.description: The massive floating hedron where the survivors of Sea Gate have made camp.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: Zendikar's foremost city, fallen to the Eldrazi, which Gideon proposes to retake.

entities.name: Zulaport
entities.description: The safehold Vorik and Tazri plan to evacuate to.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: The island the survivors would cross.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monsters overrunning Zendikar whose corruption kills Vorik.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane being overrun by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: The Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The place Jace has gone to learn the power of the hedrons.

entities.name: The Zendikari refugees
entities.description: The survivors and refugees who gather at Sky Rock.

events.summary: Gideon and Abeena haul a floating waterfall over Sky Rock to give the survivors fresh water.
events.quote: A final yank heaved the waterfall straight over Sky Rock.

events.summary: Tazri accuses Gideon of wasting time and of waiting for Jace, and Gideon admits he is not from Zendikar.
events.quote: "You're right. I'm not from this world."

events.summary: Seble flies Gideon to intercept a flying Eldrazi pursuing a party of refugees, and Gideon kills it after being thrown from the manta.
events.quote: he drove the Eldrazi straight into the ground

events.summary: Gideon concludes the people cannot survive an evacuation to Zulaport and must stay.
events.quote: They had to stay. If they wanted to survive, they had to stay here.

events.summary: A group of refugees insists that Sea Gate is Zendikar's only hope, and Tazri tells them it is gone.
Gideon argues before the dying Vorik for retaking Sea Gate instead of evacuating to Zulaport.
events.quote: "I would have us go back to Sea Gate."

events.summary: Vorik names Gideon Commander-General of the Zendikari and tells Tazri to support him.
events.quote: You will reclaim Sea Gate, Commander-General Jura.

events.summary: Vorik dies, entrusting Zendikar to Gideon.
At Vorik's funeral Gideon rallies the survivors to fight back and retake Sea Gate rather than flee.
events.quote: We can choose to fight back.

events.summary: Tazri pledges to fight beside Gideon, and the crowd cries 'For Zendikar!'
events.quote: "For Zendikar, Commander, I will battle too."

relations.quote: When I am gone, you will lead these people.

relations.note: Opposes him but pledges to battle alongside him.
relations.quote: "For Zendikar, Commander, I will battle too."
the smell of Eldrazi corruption. It came from Vorik's breath.
With help from the kor Abeena
